title: Numbers, chars and text in one expression

blocks.text: `+` turns every other operand into text once a String is involved, and it works left to right: `"Sum: " + 2 + 3` is `"Sum: 23"`, while `"Sum: " + (2 + 3)` is `"Sum: 5"`. Two `char`s added together are numbers, not text: `'A' + 'B'` is `131`.

items: `describe(int number, boolean flag, double value)`: `describe(42, true, 3.14)` is `"Number: 42, Flag: true, Value: 3.14"`.
`total(String label, int a, int b)`: `total("Sum", 2, 3)` is `"Sum: 5"`.

cases.says: describe(42, true, 3.14) reads "Number: 42, Flag: true, Value: 3.14".

concepts: + converts other operands to text, left to right, so numbers are added only inside parentheses and chars are added as numbers.
